title: Privilege Sentry: Console guardrails for role-aware cost & rollout lens (prototype + review)
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Design prototype and review for 'Privilege Sentry' — a consolidated console experience that ties role and permission changes to cost and rollout impact. Goals: (1) make it trivial for admins to preview who gains or loses access when a change is proposed, (2) surface token-level and model-level cost exposure by role, and (3) provide rollout guardrails (canaries, forced approvals) that are integrated into RBAC flows and audit logs. This ticket captures exploration screens, interaction flows, accessibility considerations, and feedback captured during stakeholder reviews.
problem_statement: Admins today juggle three disjoint surfaces: roles & permission editors, cost dashboards, and rollout controls. This separation causes mistakes (overbroad grants), unexpected cost spikes, and opaque audit trails during rollouts. We need a unified, low-noise UX to reduce blast radius for permission changes and make cost ownership explicit.
user_personas: Workspace Admin — configures roles and audits access
Platform PM — needs to understand cost ownership during rollouts
Security Auditor — verifies least-privilege and change history
deliverables: Clickable flow for role-change preview & diff
Accessibility checklist (contrast, keyboard nav, ARIA labels)
Handover pack for frontend: tokens, spacing, component variants
design_decisions: Use a side-by-side diff panel for 'Before / After' permission state to reduce cognitive load
Represent cost exposure as a per-role estimate (monthly USD) derived from token-level attribution — shown with 90% CI
Default rollout policy is 'canary-to-5% with forced approval' for permission changes that affect roles with high cost exposure
Inline audit entries will surface 'policy anchors' (e.g., linked PRD or approval ticket) to make changes traceable
tradeoffs: Showing cost estimates inline increases UI complexity — mitigated by collapsing values behind a chevron and offering 'show details'
Strong defaults (canary) may slow fast-moving teams; added 'override with justification' to balance velocity and safety
Per-role cost attribution is an approximation; documentation must surface assumptions and sampling windows

acceptance_criteria: Prototype supports Before/After role diff for at least three common role templates
Cost-attribution overlay shows an estimate and sampling window with clear caveats
Rollout flow ties permission changes to a default canary policy and allows override with justification
Audit entries persist a link back to the permission diff and override justification
ux_notes: Use clear color semantics for permission changes: green = granted, red = revoked, amber = scope-reduced
Avoid jargon: use 'members' not 'principals' in admin-facing copy
Keyboard-first interactions for diff review and approval modal
accessibility_considerations: Contrast ratios >= 4.5:1 for all diff badges
Screenreader-friendly summary at top of diff panel
Focusable elements in approval flow must have visible focus ring and ARIA labels
implementation_risks: Per-role token attribution may be noisy for shared API keys
Large workspaces (>10k members) require pagination and sampling to keep diff performant
Audit log schema changes required to persist override justification and policy anchors
qa_notes: Test role-change diffs on small ~10 user workspace and large ~12k user workspace
Simulate backend metric lag and validate graceful fallback UI
E2E test for approval override persistence in audit log
review_outcome: Incorporate sampling window and feature-flagged rollout. Security approved pending retention policy confirmation.
final_notes: This ticket is a design slice: implementable by frontend + spike for metrics. If the engineering spike shows metric gaps, we will ship a scaled-down GA: workspace-level cost exposure + role diff without per-role dollars. Keep release toggled behind 'privilege-sentry' feature flag and schedule a follow-up to evaluate post-launch telemetry.
public_title_hint: Privilege Sentry: preview permission changes and see cost impact before you roll out
